_why: Strings that read the same in every language: brand and product names, people, U.S. states, units and sizes, document titles, verbatim review quotes and video titles. Everything else needs a translation in src/locales. "ids" are internal keys in [label, id] pairs that look like words but are never shown. Review quotes stay word for word in English, as on the rest of the site.
